submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 with a 40 GeV threshold is recommended as it achieves the highest signal efficiency (84.909%) among all viable options while satisfying all constraints. Algorithm-L1 must be excluded due to latency exceeding the 4.0 μs hard limit imposed by front-end buffer constraints. Between the two compliant algorithms (L2 and L3), Algorithm-L3 provides a significant efficiency improvement of 11.7 percentage points over Algorithm-L2 (84.909% vs 73.196%). The 40 GeV threshold optimizes signal efficiency within the allowed 20-60 GeV range and keeps the trigger rate at the allocated 8 kHz. This configuration directly fulfills the primary goal of achieving the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 at 40 GeV achieves 84.909% efficiency, the maximum among all compliant options. This is 11.7 percentage points better than Algorithm-L2 (73.196%) and represents the optimal performance achievable within constraints.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm latency on Level-1 FPGA hardware must not exceed 4.0 us
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 satisfies the latency constraint (algorithm_L3_satisfies_latency = 1), while Algorithm-L1 fails this hard requirement (algorithm_L1_satisfies_latency = 0).
The recommended threshold of 40 GeV falls within the required range of 20-60 GeV (threshold_constraint_satisfied = 1).
